items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: “Soshū no yoru” is a Japanese pop tune [composed by Saijō Yaso and Niki Kitao].

ctx.x: “Soshū no yoru” is a Japanese pop tune [composed by Saijō Yaso and Niki Kitao]. Pop music. “Soshū” is the name of a place in China [Sūzhōu]. Yoru is “evening,” as you know. “Evening of Soshū,” that‟s how it‟s supposed to be.
